Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed head-on mtoor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and
reduced range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the force of the collision and with the
clinical presentation. Over the course of 23 visits, care included manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home
exercise instruction, progressing in a typical pattern for cervical strain. Visit frequency decreased as symptoms
improved and the patient reported steady functional gains. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and
restricted cervical rotation that support the diagnosis, while neurological screening and motor testing were within
normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the cervical spine is known to this provider. Note that two similar billing
entries dated to the same day are currently under review for accuracy and are not yet resolved. Patient is discharged
from active care with instructions to continue home exercises and return if symptoms recur.

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.
